title: A held business name does not demand unused rendered name files or relax independent logo review
steps: Check a complete held-name brand file and its historical gate, including reviewed fitted marks and owner confirmation.
expect: A missing or withheld name accepts mark-only spots without fabricating name pictures.
An authored but explicitly withheld name cannot be composed into new name assets.
Owner confirmation, independent review and contrast remain required; historical runs retain their recorded behavior.
New runs freeze the held-name policy; unsupported policy versions refuse.
fence: Preserve approved prompts, authored research, historical checker semantics and independent review. Never infer a withheld name from a logo.

tests: a held null name accepts reviewed fitted marks without inventing unused name pictures
an explicitly withheld authored name also keeps composed name images out of the brand file
holding a name still requires owner confirmation and independently reviewed spot files
a historical brand gate retains its recorded missing-name behavior
new brand runs freeze the held-name policy and unsupported versions refuse
the safe version never renders an explicitly held name in a new run
the safe version refuses unsupported held-name versions before invoking tools
